extracted.name: Baked Jalapeño Poppers
extracted.description: These baked jalapeño poppers forgo the frying but keep all the creamy goodness of Cheddar and cream cheese in this easy-to-prep, popular appetizer.
ingredient_lines: 12 jalapeno peppers, halved lengthwise and seeded
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray.
Fill each jalapeño pepper half with cream cheese, Cheddar cheese, and bread crumbs, respectively; arrange on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until jalapeños are tender and cheese melts, about 20 minutes.
